posts.title: Materium Is on Instagram
posts.description: Materium is on Instagram now as @materium.gg, starting with a swipe-through tour of the app.

posts.title: Alchemy 1.46.0: Actions in Omnisearch
posts.description: Alchemy 1.46.0 lets omnisearch find the actions in your universes, lets you drag actions, items, and features straight into the Action Tray, and adds a Heading block and feature counters for creators.

posts.title: Alchemy 1.45.0: Emoji Reactions
posts.description: Alchemy 1.45.0 adds emoji reactions that float up the game window, lets GMs stream to YouTube from the desktop app, and adds scene sections, handout GM Notes, and calmer 3D dice.
